claims.claim: Origen of Alexandria (c. 185–c. 254); Caesarea preacher; first systematic theologian; died of Decian-persecution injuries.
Dialogue with Heraclides records an Arabian council (c. 244–249) correcting Heraclides on Trinity/resurrection; On Pascha c. 245.
SCOPE: Dialogue + On Pascha with navigable Bible refs.
